chain.title: {board}: chain {number}
chain.description: Pick the lists that make a chain, in the order a card moves through them. Ticking a to-do item on one of these lists moves the card to the next. Leave it empty for no chain.

data.add_another: Add another chain for this board

error.chain_too_short: A chain needs at least two lists.

move_card.name: Move card
move_card.description: Moves a card to the next or previous list of its chain, or to a named list on the same board.

item.name: Card
item.description: The name or ID of the card.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Move along the chain. Going past the last list archives the card.

list.name: List
list.description: The name or ID of a list on the same board, in place of a direction.
